_comment: OVERHEAD ATTRIBUTION for the DeepSeek-V4-Flash Thesis-2 showcase, produced by the overhead-attribution skill on a REAL run (job 372849, tp=4, GNR, fp8+DSA, input-len 8 output-len 2). This is the skill USED on the showcase, not theory: it splits the measured decode time into optimized-KERNEL vs unoptimized-TORCH vs FRAMEWORK, and each bucket routes to a different lever. Source: INTEL_CPU_DSV4_TIMEIT=1 boundary timers (per-rank, tp-safe). Percentages below are of the WRAPPED leaf time (parents moe.forward/mla_attention excluded to avoid double counting); ~dense proj/norm/rope/lm_head are still UNATTRIBUTED and need the op-level profiler (next step).

leaf_ops.note: native fused_experts_cpu (FP8_W8A16: fp8 weights, bf16 acts, VNNI). ISOLATION at Flash shape (H=4096, I=2048, top-6): per-expert bf16 GEMM pair 0.33ms, 6-expert fp8 weight-stream floor 0.67ms -> should be ~1-2ms/call, measured 1920ms/call = ~1000-2000x above floor -> KERNEL-CONFIG problem (prime suspect: tp=4 thread-binding and/or all-256-expert streaming), NOT a new kernel. Confirm via [MOE DIAG] real thread count.
fp32 QK/softmax/PV matmuls. Real-scale CONFIRMS tiny: attend is ~all of MLA; gather+select ~0.03s. Lever = bf16/AMX attend (reference is bf16).
torch compressor(compute_kv_score+softmax-pool)+rmsnorm+mask (NOT the logits GEMM, which is sub-ms). Lever = co-design/vectorize.
moe.forward (570s) - expert_apply (329s) = gate/topk/dispatch/combine/shared. Lever = fusion/vectorize, no kernel.
negligible -> the earlier vectorized-gather idea would NOT have moved the needle (measure-first).

torch.lever: author/route kernels + co-design (bf16 attend, vectorize indexer/compressor) -- the Thesis-2 work

kernel.lever: kernel-ISOLATION vs uPP floor: fused_experts 1.92s/call is ~1000x above floor -> config (threads/prepack/dtype/ISA), NOT a new kernel

framework.lever: fusion / fewer ops / vectorize routing -- no kernel

unattributed_note: The wrapped leaf ops cover the DSA + MoE; dense proj (fp8_scaled_mm), rmsnorm, rope, lm_head, embed are NOT yet wrapped (~the rest of wall time). NEXT: op-level profiler (torch.profiler/per-rank cProfile) to attribute them before committing more budget.
decisions: MLA: fix the ATTEND phase (bf16/AMX), gated by output-tolerance parity. gather/select are ~0 -> do NOT touch them.
MoE: the 'AMX' fused_experts is itself ~1000x above floor -> kernel-isolation (a config problem surfaced early), potentially the single biggest lever.
Profile the unattributed dense/norm/lm_head remainder next.
